Class ClientDiagnostics

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.client.ClientDiagnostics
@Environment(CLIENT) public final class ClientDiagnostics extends Object
The client /sb operator diagnostics. They read client resources and the loader's client fluid data, so they exist only on the physical client; on a dedicated server an operator runs them from a connected client and the report lands there.
  • /sb fluids walks every registered source fluid and computes its Big and Huge Bucket bar color through ClientPlatform.barColor(StoredFluid, int), so a modpack's fluids can be checked for ones that render as the fallback color or collapse to near-black.
  • /sb eggs renders every spawn egg, samples the two-color palette the Mob Bucket tints its overlays with, and reports each entity type's colors, flagging capturable types that have no egg or whose egg could not be sampled. Types listed in mob_egg_colors.json report their override colors and are not flagged. It also writes a thumbnail contact sheet of the sampled eggs; sampling waits on GPU readbacks, so this report completes asynchronously.

Each writes <configDir>/somebuckets/<report>, overwriting any previous run, and sends a summary to the command source. Every finding reaches the operator through that summary and the written report; none is logged.
